name: Jorah phone
description: phone_today: what Adam's iPhone reported today (place by geofence name, wake time, Focus, and, only if Adam turned it on, last night's sleep, HRV, resting heart rate and today's workouts), read from the jorah-phone service on loopback and checked against its schema (docs/contracts/jorah-phone-v1.md). Every field is written by code; missing data is null, never zero.

serviceUrl.description: jorah-phone on loopback, no path. Only 127.0.0.1 or localhost is accepted

tokenFile.description: The read-scope token, mode 600, read per call. Never the token itself

includeHealth.description: Pass health fields to Jorah. Off until Adam's decision H; the service has its own switch too

contractsDir.description: Where today.schema.json is. Default: packages/contracts/phone next to this plugin in the repo
